metadata.title: Exploring the nature of the unidentified VHE gamma-ray source HESS J1507-622

notes: No eligible stars. The paper studies the unidentified extended VHE gamma-ray source HESS J1507-622 and its possible Fermi counterpart 2FGL J1507.0-6223, not an identifiable star. It explicitly states that "So far no pulsar could be identified in the vicinity of the H.E.S.S. source" (T:p1-b13). The discussion of a possible Galactic-halo location or of a pulsar born from a massive star ejected from the Galaxy (e.g. T:p6-b1) invokes proposed origins/scenarios for the gamma-ray source; it does not identify a particular star or establish that any star is presently unbound from the Milky Way. Thus neither contribution category is met.
